text: A stranger texts you, get paid just for liking videos, and the first payment is real.
The US regulator, the FTC, calls this a task scam.
You like videos or rate products in sets of 40, and an app shows your earnings climbing.
To unlock it, you must deposit your own money, usually in crypto.
The balance on screen keeps growing, but it was never real.
Reports jumped from about $5,000 in all of 2023 to about $20,000 in just the first half
The Better Business Bureau says the typical task scam victim lost about $2,300 in 2025.
The first few dollars are bait for your deposit.
So the job was paying me with my own money?
Have you ever got a text like this?
